Equations and problem definitions Fixed SPD matrix of size 12, a nearly singular rank-one matrix of size 8, Hilbert matrix of size 5 and Wilkinson matrix of size 12. Factors and triangular corrections use binary32; residuals use binary64, with five updates. Fixed LU, Cholesky, refinement and symmetric-indefinite saddle controls are distinct from continuum PDE solutions.
